page.notes: Doubtful readings: "splendicanti" (the printed word at the line end is hard to make out, [?] advisable); "saberrimè" likely "faberrimè" in print, the letter is unclear; "circumdatum" is followed by a dash-like mark, possibly a stop or a pointer; "inserereremus" may be a printing error for "inserueremus" (left as printed); "Inscri-" is the last line and continues on the next page. "Pr. in-victisss" is printed with a long s followed by an f-like form; read as "invictissimi" would be a normalisation and is not applied. The black letter "den neuen Bau" is set in Gothic type within italic text. The page has no catchword or signature.
